Adjectives agree in gender and number with the noun they modify.

Most commonly placed after the noun, but some adjectives may come before for emphasis or poetic effect.

Masculine adjectives often end in -o, and feminine in -a; plural usually adds -s or -es.

Some adjectives are invariable (do not change), especially those borrowed from other languages or used as color names.
